$comment: Machine-readable surface for /apply-pattern. Human spec: patterns/open-beta-probe/pattern.md. Third validation-experiment pattern (chief-wiggum#256): a working, deliberately-scoped product put in real hands via an existing community, metered by signup codes. Recalibrates the evidence ladder — build cost collapsed and the smoke-test signal degraded, so a strength-3/4 open beta is now often the better first instrument than a strength-2 smoke test. Pre-registration/vanity-lint invariants grounded in the in-repo assumption.py mechanism; the code-metering/blast-radius/reputation invariants are design-derived (no shipped app has run this stamped experiment yet — honest per issue #139's allowance).
title: Open-Beta Probe
applies_when: a demand assumption needs commitment-class-adjacent evidence (strength 3-4, time/reputation) cheaper than a full presale
the product can genuinely be built to a working, deliberately-scoped state before the test (build cost has collapsed for software this size)
an existing community or channel exists to launch a metered beta into
the operator can honestly answer the blast-radius question and accept compute-only/draft-only scope if the answer is unbounded
components: signup-code-issuance: unique, trackable, revocable codes minted per cohort — the metering AND scarcity mechanism a public waitlist form does not provide
code-redemption-tracking: redemption and revocation recorded per cohort, feeding the per-cohort returning-user rate
blast-radius-declaration: a mandatory bounded|unbounded declaration at stamp time; stamping is refused without it
compute-only-mode-guard: when blast_radius=unbounded, the beta computes/presents an artifact for human review and cannot commit the irreversible act
pre-registered-binding: the beta binds to an assumption.py test card (strength 3-4) whose threshold block was hashed into the portfolio journal before it opened
per-cohort-rate-metric: the success criterion is a per-cohort returning-user/real-work-done rate; cumulative redemption counts are rejected by the vanity-metric lint

invariants.$comment: 001-002 are realized by the in-repo validation engine (scripts/assumption.py); 003-006 are design-derived code-metering/blast-radius/reputation/evidence rules, honestly flagged until first grounded use.

cluster.statement: Pre-registered success bar: the beta binds to a test card (evidence strength 3-4, time/reputation) whose threshold block was content-hashed into the portfolio journal BEFORE the beta opened; the verdict is recorded only against that original hash.

realized_as.code: scripts/assumption.py (card-create threshold hash + verdict enforcement, chief-wiggum#236)

cluster.statement: Per-cohort rate, never a raw signup/redemption counter: the success criterion is a per-cohort returning-user/real-work-done rate among redeemed codes; cumulative redemption totals are rejected as success criteria (they falsify nothing).

Signup-code metering: every beta participant enters via a unique, trackable, revocable signup code; issuance, redemption, and revocation are all recorded per cohort — codes are the attribution and scarcity mechanism a public form does not provide.

Blast-radius declaration is mandatory at stamp time; the pattern refuses to stamp without a bounded|unbounded declaration. bounded (no irreversible external effect) may run live; unbounded (touches money, wages, tax, health, published records, or third-party systems) MUST run in compute-only/draft-only mode — the beta computes and presents an artifact for human review and cannot itself commit the irreversible act.

Reputation is single-use: a given community can be launched to once per bet; a beta shipped before it works burns the audience the bet depends on. This is a cost priced into the affordable-loss envelope, never treated as a free externality.

Honest evidence-strength floor: a bare code redemption is strength-2 (click) evidence at best; the strength-3/4 claim requires a RETURNING user who did real work in the product, never a single visit or bare signup.

product_name.description: The product the open beta probes.

blast_radius.description: REQUIRED, no default (INV-OBP-004) — stamping is refused without it. bounded = no irreversible external effect, may run live. unbounded = touches money/wages/tax/health/published records/third-party systems, MUST run compute-only/draft-only.

community_channel.default: an existing community/channel (bind this before launch)
community_channel.description: The existing community/channel the beta launches into (not a discovery mechanism — the audience must already exist).

code_issuance_endpoint.description: Where the signup-codes stub issues/redeems/revokes codes (bind to a real store before launch).

success_metrics.$comment: Per-cohort rates only (INV-OBP-002). The bound test card's threshold is the pre-registered pass bar.

metrics.desc: redeemed codes whose holder returned and did real work / redeemed codes per cohort — the experiment's primary (strength 3-4) measure
outreach + support spend / redeemed codes per cohort (counts against the bet envelope)

protected_paths: the stamped blast-radius declaration + signup-codes stub (the compute-only guard is only meaningful if it matched what was declared)
